summary: Iteration 53 — Per-Channel Routing for Deployment Center alert channels. Backend pytest 5/5 PASSED (test_iter53_channel_routing.py): (1) GET /api/admin/deploy/alert-channels returns slack_mode/discord_mode/whatsapp_mode/webhook_mode. (2) PUT persists all 4 modes+urls (verified via subsequent GET). (3) Invalid mode string falls back to 'all'. (4) Routing filter independently re-verified via httpx logs in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: with discord=maintenance/whatsapp=outages/webhook=all, a degraded incident produced only POST httpbin.org/status/203 (all), and an outage incident produced /203 + /202 (whatsapp outages); /201 (discord maintenance) never fired — 0 hits across the whole test window. (5) Cleanup resets all URLs to '' and modes to 'all' (verified via GET). Frontend Playwright: logged in as admin, opened Admin → Deployment → 'Channels' (channels-toggle-btn) → alert-channels-panel renders 4 rows each with an input + mode select. All four mode selects (slack-mode-select, discord-mode-select, whatsapp-mode-select, webhook-url-mode-select) expose the exact options ['All events','Incidents','Outages only','Maintenance only']. Filled distinct URLs (/201,/202,/203) and set modes to incidents/maintenance/outages/all, clicked save-channels-btn → 'Alert channels saved' toast visible. After a full page reload, all 4 mode values + URL values persist (GET-backed). test-channels-btn dispatch still works (Send test alert visible + saved-first flow). Regression: incidents-toggle-btn, embed-toggle-btn, domain-toggle-btn all still open their panels; public /status renders HTTP 200 (~329k chars). Post-test cleanup completed via UI + verified with reload: all 4 channel inputs empty, all 4 modes reset to 'all'. All test-created incidents (6) resolved via /api/admin/deploy/status-incidents/{id}/update {resolve:true}.
